tldr: For the truly optimal conditional-median value near a treatment tie, observing the treatment contrast improves the optimal blind expected interval length by \(zD^6/(512\tau)+O(D^8)\). A deterministic fixed-width interval attains this leading gain with honest coverage over the full gap continuum, no randomized finite connected interval improves its leading term, information is strictly useful at every positive radius, and the frontier transfers to the full original Gaussian treatment record. Historical largest-mean theorem access remains an explicit priority limitation.
gap: Leqi--Kennedy\textquotesingle s optimal-value limit theorem uses a positive margin exponent; its proof does not cover a positive-mass treatment tie. General minimax expected-size duality does not evaluate the sharp information gain of a bounded contrast with unrestricted common location. No inspected source supplies this exact small-gap all-action order and constant; historical primary theorem and correction access prevents an unconditional priority claim.
fill: A sharp equivalent requires matching continuum lower and upper bounds across every finite connected interval action, an interval honest at every intermediate gap, and expected-length-preserving transfer under random treatment counts. Generic kernel computation, a fixed-width witness alone, or the pooled tie result does not meet this target.
